# Genfeed.ai Docs

> Self-hosting documentation for Genfeed, the open source AI OS for content creation.

## Self-host

- [Installation Options](https://docs.genfeed.ai/self-host/installation): npx one-command install, release bundle with Docker Compose, and from source.
- [System Requirements](https://docs.genfeed.ai/self-host/system-requirements): Supported floor, recommended sizing, and measured facts.
- [Configuration](https://docs.genfeed.ai/self-host/configuration): Environment variable reference.
- [Provider API Keys](https://docs.genfeed.ai/self-host/provider-api-keys): Bring your own OpenAI, Anthropic, Replicate, fal, and ElevenLabs keys.
- [Reverse Proxy and HTTPS](https://docs.genfeed.ai/self-host/reverse-proxy): Put your instance on your own domain.
- [Upgrading](https://docs.genfeed.ai/self-host/upgrading): Back up, upgrade, and roll back.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.genfeed.ai/self-host/troubleshooting): Docker Compose v2, database networking, ports, and MCP.
- [Architecture](https://docs.genfeed.ai/self-host/architecture): Which services run and where data lives.
- [After It Is Running](https://docs.genfeed.ai/self-host/after-it-is-running): First steps: keys, MCP, CLI, Agent Skills, first brief to publish.

## API, MCP, CLI

- [API Reference](https://docs.genfeed.ai/api-reference): REST API of your instance.
- [MCP Server](https://docs.genfeed.ai/api-reference/mcp): Connect agents to the MCP server on port 3014.
- [CLI](https://docs.genfeed.ai/api-reference/cli): Terminal client pointed at your own API.
- [Agent Skills](https://docs.genfeed.ai/skills): Content skills for agents.
- [Provider Registry](https://docs.genfeed.ai/self-host/provider-registry): AI provider registry contract.

## Content Loop

- [Agent Orchestration](https://docs.genfeed.ai/core-loop/agent-orchestration): Agent and workflow execution model.
- [Trend Ingestion](https://docs.genfeed.ai/core-loop/trend-ingestion): Reference and trend ingestion.

## Optional

- [Guides](https://docs.genfeed.ai/guides): Brands, Studio, publishing, and other product guides.
- [Capabilities](https://docs.genfeed.ai/features): What a self-hosted instance includes.
